attackers_goals: An attacker can add an authentication method to an account, so they can have later access to the tenant and resources.
description: An identity attempted to add an Azure authentication method.
investigative_actions: Check if the authentication method is legitimate in the organization. Check whether the identity is permitted to perform such actions. Follow the account for possible suspicious or unusual logins.
name: Authentication method added to an Azure account
